item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-24
item.description: "Black Duck (former Synopsys Software Integrity Group) announces exit from the Chinese market — closing its subsidiary 百达科软件 (Baidake), laying off over 40 employees, and winding down by September 30, 2026; the move eliminates the only enterprise-grade, Western-sourced open-source compliance and license-governance tool currently operating inside China — creating an institutional-compliance-vacuum that no domestic Chinese SCA vendor has documented capacity to fill at the same institutional tier; MirrorZ — the CERNET-backed joint mirror station (校园网联合镜像站) — announces its official public launch, federating the existing open-source mirror infrastructure of 27 Chinese universities plus the Chinese Academy of Sciences into a single 302-redirect governance surface without replicating data — a structurally new federated-commons governance instrument on the Chinese academic network; DeepSeek Harness (MIT-licensed agent runtime, August 13 developer preview) moves V4-Pro to a peak/off-peak token-pricing architecture on August 16 that independent analysis finds is in fact a 2.28x–4.55x price increase dressed in off-peak-discount framing — a structurally new monetization-architecture phase of DeepSeek's open-weight institutional ecosystem."
